cmsy_download_jags(): 下载适合本机的JAGS安装程序

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/cmsy_download_jags.Rmd
cmsy_download_jags.Rmd

英文原页：cmsy_download_jags()

说明

本函数选出与操作系统、R版本和处理器匹配的JAGS安装程序（见cmsy_jags_versions()），从其固定链接下载，并核对文件大小和校验值（MD5，以及R能够计算时的SHA-256）。对于JAGS 5，还会下载配套的rjags 5-3包。也可以下载其他系统或其他R版本的安装程序，例如用于在无法联网的电脑上安装JAGS，或者为同事下载。

English

This function picks the JAGS installer that matches the operating system, the R version and the processor (see cmsy_jags_versions()), downloads it from its pinned link, and checks its size and checksums (MD5, and SHA-256 when R can compute it). For JAGS 5 it also downloads the matching rjags 5-3 package. It can also download the installers of other systems or R versions, e.g. to install JAGS on computers without internet or for colleagues.

用法 

cmsy_download_jags(
  version = "recommended",
  os = "auto",
  r_version = getRversion(),
  arch = "auto",
  dest = NULL,
  rjags = TRUE,
  data_dir = fao_data_dir(),
  silent = fao_setting("silent")
)

参数

version
“recommended”（默认：适合当前R版本的JAGS 4，可与CRAN上的rjags配合使用）、“latest”（JAGS 5.0.0和rjags 5-3）或JAGS版本号，例如”4.3.1”。
English “recommended” (default: JAGS 4 for this R version, which works with rjags from CRAN), “latest” (JAGS 5.0.0 with rjags 5-3) or a JAGS version such as “4.3.1”.
os
“auto”（默认，本机）、“windows”、“macos”、“linux”或”all”（r_version对应的全部三个系统的安装程序）。
English “auto” (default, this computer), “windows”, “macos”, “linux” or “all” (the installers of all three systems for r_version).
r_version
安装程序所针对的R版本。默认为当前运行的R版本。
English The R version the installer is for. Default is the running R.
arch
处理器类型，用于选择macOS上rjags 5的二进制包：“auto”（默认）、“arm64”（Apple芯片）或”x86_64”（Intel）。
English The processor, for the rjags 5 binary on macOS: “auto” (default), “arm64” (Apple silicon) or “x86_64” (Intel).
dest
可选，把文件复制到的文件夹。
English Optional folder to copy the files to.
rjags
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，还下载JAGS 5所需的rjags包（JAGS 4所用的rjags 4-17由cmsy_setup()从CRAN安装）。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), the rjags package needed by JAGS 5 is also downloaded (rjags 4-17 for JAGS 4 is installed from CRAN by cmsy_setup()).
data_dir
下载文件的保存目录。默认为fao_data_dir()。
English The directory where downloads are kept. Default is fao_data_dir().
silent
逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，报告匹配结果和下载情况。
English A logical value. If FALSE (default), the matching and the download are reported.

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每个文件一行：系统、R版本、组件、版本、文件名、本地路径、链接、SHA-256，以及校验值是否相符（即已核对的项目；不相符时会报错）。

English

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per file: system, R version, component, version, file, local path, link, SHA-256 and whether the checksums matched.

详细说明

文件保存在本包的下载文件夹（fao_data_dir()/cmsy/downloads）中，因此只需下载一次；给出dest时还会复制到dest。打开安装程序即可安装JAGS（cmsy_install_jags()或cmsy_setup()会自动打开），安装后请重启R。

English

The files are kept in the download folder of the package (fao_data_dir()/cmsy/downloads), so they are downloaded only once, and copied to dest when given. Install JAGS by opening the installer (cmsy_install_jags() or cmsy_setup() do this) and restart R.

参考文献

Plummer, M. (2003). JAGS: A program for analysis of Bayesian graphical models using Gibbs sampling. Proceedings of the 3rd International Workshop on Distributed Statistical Computing (DSC 2003), Vienna. https://mcmc-jags.sourceforge.io/

示例 

# The installer for this computer (JAGS 4 for this R version)
cmsy_download_jags()

# JAGS 5.0.0 and the matching rjags 5-3
cmsy_download_jags(version = "latest")

# All three systems for R 4.4, copied to a folder to share in a lab
cmsy_download_jags(os = "all", r_version = "4.4.1", dest = "jags_installers")
